body:
Stack from [ghstack](https://github.com/ezyang/ghstack/tree/0.17.0) (oldest at bottom):
* __->__ #185916

FlexAttention lowers score_mod indexing through ModIndex, so a score_mod such as
table[idx][j] on a captured tensor that requires grad produces nested
zeros_and_scatter calls in the joint backward graph:

    zeros_and_scatter(shape, [idx], zeros_and_scatter(inner_shape, [j], grad))

Inductor's validate_joint_graph rejects any zeros_and_scatter whose result
feeds something other than the graph output, so the compiled backward raised
NotImplementedError even though the graph is equivalent to the backward of
table[idx, j].

Before validating the joint graph, run a FlexAttention-local
PatternMatcherPass that rewrites the nested pair into a single
zeros_and_scatter(shape, [idx, j], grad). The rewrite fires only when
shape[len(indices):] is statically equal to inner_shape (via sym_eq, so it
also works with dynamic shapes), and repeats until no match is left so longer
chains collapse. Anything that still leaves an intermediate scatter, such as
(table[idx] * 2)[0], is still rejected by the existing validator, whose message
now also suggests merging the indices into one indexing expression.

This fix is compiled-only. Eager and aot_eager still fail in the
zeros_and_scatter vmap rule for the nested pattern, so this does not fully
resolve #146896. An earlier revision of this PR also rewrote and validated the
joint graph in the HOP to cover eager. Review judged that extra complexity not
worth it, because writing table[idx, j] already avoids the problem.

Authored with an AI assistant (Claude).

Test Plan:

```
python test/inductor/test_flex_attention.py -k index_backward
python test/inductor/test_flex_attention.py -k test_symmetric_bias
lintrunner -a
```

The new nested-index tests fail with the validator's NotImplementedError when
the new pass is disabled. The shape_1_index_0 case is the pattern from #146896.
On that repro, eager and aot_eager still raise the vmap rule's AssertionError.

title: Fix FlexAttention nested index backward in Inductor
